name: Duelist's Comate
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 216
Aura strong transmutation CL 13th
Slot none; Price 35,320 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This +2 counteringUE duelingUE rapier is particularly well balanced, and features a stout steel ball on the pommel. Three times per day, the wielder can make a surprise melee attack with the pommel as a swift action, as if proficient with the attack and at her normal attack bonus. The attack deals 1d6+2 points of bludgeoning damage, and the critical multiplier is 20/×2.
Construction
Requirements Combat Reflexes, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace, daze; Price 17,820 gp
